subject: Peace Talks Failed (again...) Now What?!

self_score.quote: S&P rallied 4.48% last week, making three new record highs

spy_levels.sentence: Ideally the prior ATH level at 698 would act supportive.
If the pullback is deeper than that something around 676 offers a ton of confluence with the weekly 20 SMA, aVWAP stack, Fib 38.2.
Would prefer that the market didn't 100% retrace last weeks move to the 50 SMA and weekly ideal HL around 676 area, but thats hypothetically where we can go.

swing_ideas.text: Full year consolidation starting to break out last week. Looking for signs that this is ready to go via daily higher lows over 215.75 area.
Shallow cup and handle forming on the daily that make up a weekly bull flag up here. Looking for breakouts over the 165 area for blue sky territory.
Flat top base breakout available after Friday's move higher. Would prefer a day or two pause and then a break from a bullish 3 bar play on the daily.
Higher low over the daily 20 SMA and now inside three bar play as of Friday's action. Looking for a break over 104.75 for a move into new record highs.
